conventions.heading: degrees true, clockwise from north
conventions.bank: positive right turn; negative left turn
conventions.vertical_speed: feet per minute; negative for descent
conventions.altitude: height above water required by the reference model

parameters.name: altitude_ft_above_water
parameters.note: The application stores an approximately 908 ft label. Datum and rounding require source confirmation before use as height above water.

parameters.name: modeled_poi_lat_deg
parameters.note: Stored modeled water-contact reference. Compare it with a documented contact and recovery area; do not treat it as an exact final resting position or use it to tune an independent propagation.

parameters.name: modeled_poi_lon_deg
parameters.note: Stored modeled water-contact reference. Compare it with a documented contact and recovery area; do not treat it as an exact final resting position or use it to tune an independent propagation.

parameters.name: airspeed_kt
parameters.note: Do not silently substitute groundspeed. Provide an airspeed source or a documented conversion model.

parameters.name: groundspeed_kt
parameters.note: Needed if ADS-B groundspeed is used to infer airspeed with wind.

parameters.name: heading_deg_true
parameters.note: Specify whether the source is track, heading, or an inferred orientation.

parameters.name: bank_deg
parameters.note: Use a range when not directly observed. Negative values represent a left turn in the reference model.

parameters.name: flight_path_angle_deg
parameters.note: Supply this or vertical_speed_fpm, not both.

parameters.name: vertical_speed_fpm
parameters.note: Supply this or flight_path_angle_deg, not both. Negative values indicate descent.

parameters.name: wind_speed_kt
parameters.note: Use time- and altitude-appropriate wind evidence. Enter zero only with a documented still-air assumption.

parameters.name: wind_from_deg_true
parameters.note: Meteorological FROM convention. A direction is still required when wind speed is zero by the current input validator.

parameters.name: stall_speed_wings_level_kt
parameters.note: Required to apply the accelerated-stall gate. If omitted, the model can propagate but cannot establish controlled-flight validity against stall speed.

parameters.name: dt_s
parameters.note: Run sensitivity checks at smaller and larger steps. This is not claimed as the historical integration interval.

parameters.name: max_time_s
parameters.note: Administrative stop only. A candidate is rejected if water contact occurs later.
